text:
jia: Heads-up — onboarding Nebula7b-int4. Quick smoke showed coherent short responses but long-context summaries drift after ~1k tokens, looks like rotary/kv handshake issue. repro attached below.

sam: can you paste the minimal repro? is this on our int4 runtime or local fp16?

jia: int4 on dedicated cluster. repro: ```python
# run with rdm-infer --model nebula7b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2048
prompt = open('long_prompt.txt').read()
print(client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=1500))
```
errors: tokens after 1024 devolve into repeated phrases, and embeddings drift (cos sim drops ~0.12).

eric: sounds like kv-cache tokenid offset or rotary phase mismatch. did conversion script change head_dim ordering? any endian/stride changes?

jia: we used model-convert v2 that applies head concat optimization. config shows `rotary_scaling: per_head` and `head_dim_order: interleaved`.

maya: @sam @eric also check vocab mapping — we saw a soft-shadow case where sentinel tokens map to adjacent ids after tokenmap pack. long ctx + sentinel could cause aliasing.

sam: running quick checks: 1) compare kv-cache keys vs reference 2) run embed cos sim between fp16 baseline and int4 3) check token ids for sentinel in tokenizer.

ci-bot: Starting job nebula7b-int4-smoke (runner: ded-gpu-11). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/5589

sam: results: kv cache keys line up for first 512 tokens, divergence starts at token 1024: observed a +1 shift in k index for head groups 4..7. suspect head_dim_order mismatch during kernel mapping. attach diffs: /tmp/kv_diffs.txt

eric: that +1 smells like a pack/unpack stride off-by-one when folding heads. also check rotary sin/cos table length — if sin table computed for dim N but applied to N-2 you get phase slip later.

maya: tokenizer check: sentinel "<SENT>" id is consistent, but we do have a reserved padding alias at end-of-vocab which compresses when packing int4. Could be tokenmap hash collision on convert step.

jia: can we try rebuilding the quantized weights with head_dim_order set to "separate" (no interleave) and regen rotary tables with explicit headwise size? if that fixes we can add a preflight assert in convert.

sam: started a rebuild with `--head-order separate --rotary-mode explicit --preserve-vocab-padding` (cmd in CI). ETA ~20m.

ci-bot: nebula7b-int4-smoke rebuild finished: exit 0. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/5589/nebula7b-int4-rebuild.tgz

sam: re-ran the long prompt test. Embedding cos sim delta down to 0.01 vs fp16 baseline, no repeat drift up to 2k tokens. Looks like head-order + rotary regeneration fixed it.

eric: nice. action items: 1) add convert-time asserts for head_dim_order/stride 2) ensure rotary table length matches per-head dim before quant pack 3) add longctx eval (2k) to int4 smoke.

maya: I'll file the tokenmap collision follow-up — add preservation flag by default so padding ids aren't folded into int4 packing.

jia: thanks team — I'll update onboarding doc with a short checklist and the convert assertion PR link once up. :thumbsup:

sam: ping me when PR is ready, I'll run the broader model sweep (Zephyr, OrionRT, Nebula) overnight.

jia: noted. closing triage for now, reopening if new regressions show up. :coffee:
